messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: capacity-tier routing error - tenant shunt loop detected for tenant acme-corp. Alert id: PAGER-2319
amanda: seeing elevated 5xx from hosted pool -> dedicated... latency spike ~1200ms
raj: i'm oncall, joining. can someone paste the routing policy id?
marcos: policy id: rp-tier-12f, last changed 2026-03-14 by infra-cfg-bot
emily: quick note: acme calls are seeing model variant mismatch (gptx-8q -> gptx-8q-compat) per traces
amanda: logs:
```
2026-03-14T21:00:11Z ERROR route: tenant=acme-corp src=hosted dst=dedicated pool=dedicated-eu-west-1 variant=gptx-8q-compat reason=policy-fallback
2026-03-14T21:00:11Z WARN spillover: pool_claim=failover_to_dedicated allowed=false
```
ops-shift: @raj @marcos can we confirm isolation flag for acme-corp? should be true.
raj: checking KVS... isolation=false. uh
marcos: infra-cfg-bot deployment rolled a change to default isolation on 03/14, it flipped to false for new policies
amanda: customers: acme-corp, beta-shop, corpx. impact: elevated latency, some generation mismatches causing malformed JSON in structured outputs
customer-success: pinged ACME CSM, they're seeing degraded autocomplete in prod
raj: mitigation plan: 1) set routing sticky to hosted for acme-corp 2) enforce tenant isolation on dedicated pools 3) rollback infra-cfg-bot change
marcos: applying temporary sticky: `redwood-cli routing set-override --tenant acme-corp --mode sticky --target hosted --ttl 1800` <-- doing now
amanda: confirm overlay applied? any errors?
marcos: applied, returned 200
raj: enforcing isolation on dedicated-eu-west-1: `kubectl annotate ns dedicated-eu-west-1 tenant-isolation=true --overwrite` -> ok
emily: starting live tail to confirm: `redwoodctl tail --tenant acme-corp --since 1m`
amanda: seeing requests stay in hosted now, latency returning to baseline 80-120ms
ops-shift: rolling rollback of infra-cfg-bot change in 1m
marcos: infra-cfg-bot rollback started
incident-bot: deploy-bot: rollback of infra/cfg-service succeeded - diff revert id 67a2
raj: can someone run a smoke prompt set against acme-corp keys? check structured-output validation
amanda: ran smoke set. 20/20 passed. no more malformed JSON
customer-success: ACME CSM acknowledged, asking for RCA ETA
raj: RCA draft: config defaulted tenant-isolation=false in rp-tier-12f due to a silent flag in infra-cfg-bot; led to misrouted fallback to dedicated variant gptx-8q-compat which lacked full output schema tests. Cascade: high latencies + some malformed outputs. Immediate mitigations: sticky routing, enforced isolation, rollback. Next steps: add pre-merge check for tenant-isolation defaults, add canary for infra-cfg-bot default toggles, add evals on variant compatibility.
marcos: creating follow-up ticket INC-2391-RCA and scheduling postmortem. assigning to infra and routing teams.
raj: handing off to morning oncall @emily for follow-up and customer comms. I'm off in 10m.
emily: taking it. will own updates and the postmortem draft.
amanda: thumbs. closing pager, will monitor for 2h.
incident-bot: Pager resolved by raj — incident status: mitigated, monitored
ops-shift: note: hourly check for sticky TTL expiry at 2026-03-14T23:30Z
customer-success: ACME CSM updated: partial impact acknowledged, awaiting RCA
